what.zh: 按行打开一个文本文件，把里面的内容读进来。
what.en: Opens a text file and reads its lines into the conversation.

why.zh: 先看到真实内容再判断，避免凭印象猜测。
why.en: Looks at the real content before deciding instead of guessing.

what.zh: 用文件名或通配符在目录里查找文件路径。
what.en: Searches folders for file paths that match a name pattern.

why.zh: 先摸清有哪些文件，再决定从哪里下手。
why.en: Maps out what files exist before deciding where to start.

what.zh: 按关键词或规则搜索很多文件里的文字。
what.en: Searches the text inside many files for a keyword or pattern.

why.zh: 直接定位相关代码，省去逐个打开文件。
why.en: Jumps straight to relevant code instead of opening every file.

what.zh: 新建一个文件，或用新内容整体替换旧文件。
what.en: Creates a file, or replaces a whole file with new content.

why.zh: 把想好的结果真正保存到磁盘上，做出改动。
why.en: Turns a decision into a real change saved on disk.

what.zh: 把文件里的一小段文字替换成新的文字。
what.en: Replaces one exact piece of text inside a file.

why.zh: 只改需要改的地方，不碰其他内容，更安全。
why.en: Changes only what is needed and leaves the rest untouched.

what.zh: 打开一张图片，看到它上面画了什么。
what.en: Opens an image file and shows its visual content.

why.zh: 有些信息用眼睛看，比读文字描述更准确。
why.en: Some information is clearer seen than described in words.

what.zh: 在电脑上执行一条 PowerShell 命令。
what.en: Runs a PowerShell command on the computer.

why.zh: 借用现成工具完成检查、构建等实际动作。
why.en: Uses existing tools to inspect, build, or test things for real.

what.zh: 在系统终端里执行一条 bash 命令。
what.en: Runs a bash command in the system terminal.

why.zh: 真正动手执行任务，而不是停留在讨论上。
why.en: Actually does the job with system tools instead of just talking.

what.zh: 查看或切换当前所在的文件夹位置。
what.en: Shows or changes the folder that commands run in.

why.zh: 站对位置，后面的文件操作才不会找错地方。
why.en: Standing in the right place keeps later file operations on target.

what.zh: 获取本机自带 Python、Node 和库的安装位置。
what.en: Gets the paths of bundled Python, Node, and library folders.

why.zh: 用对现成环境，不必自己重装或猜版本。
why.en: Uses the provided environment instead of reinstalling or guessing.

what.zh: 列出正在后台运行的命令和任务。
what.en: Lists commands and jobs that are running in the background.

why.zh: 同时推进多件事时，随时掌握每件做到哪了。
why.en: Keeps track of several parallel tasks at the same time.

what.zh: 查看某个后台任务目前的输出或结果。
what.en: Shows the current output or final result of a background job.

why.zh: 确认长任务真的成功了，再继续下一步。
why.en: Confirms a long job really succeeded before moving on.

what.zh: 请求取消一个还在运行的后台任务。
what.en: Requests cancellation of a background job that is still running.

why.zh: 方向不对就及时收手，避免浪费时间和资源。
why.en: Stops early when a path is wrong, saving time and resources.

what.zh: 在网上搜索，返回若干网页和简短摘要。
what.en: Searches the internet and returns matching pages with summaries.

why.zh: 补上不知道或已经过时的最新信息。
why.en: Fills gaps where knowledge is missing or out of date.

what.zh: 下载一个网页，把正文内容取回来。
what.en: Downloads one web page and returns its readable content.

why.zh: 深入读原始材料，而不是只看搜索摘要。
why.en: Reads the original source instead of trusting a short summary.

what.zh: 载入一套预先写好的专门操作指南。
what.en: Loads a prepared set of detailed instructions for a task.

why.zh: 照着成熟流程做，复杂任务会更稳更规范。
why.en: Follows a proven procedure so complex work stays reliable.

what.zh: 把要做的事整理成一份可勾选的清单。
what.en: Records the planned steps as a checklist and updates it.

why.zh: 把大事拆成小步，边做边看得见进度。
why.en: Breaks big work into visible steps and tracks progress.

what.zh: 把完成好的文件标记为交付物给用户。
what.en: Marks finished files as final deliverables for the user.

why.zh: 让用户一眼看到最终成果，而不用翻找文件。
why.en: Puts the finished result in front of the user instead of buried files.

what.zh: 暂停一下，向用户提出选择题或确认问题。
what.en: Pauses to ask the user a question or offer choices.

why.zh: 方向不清时先问清楚，比猜错后返工更省事。
why.en: Clarifying when unsure beats guessing and redoing work.

what.zh: 把一件独立的事交给另一个 AI 助手去做。
what.en: Hands one self-contained task to a separate AI helper.

why.zh: 分头干活，主线程保持专注、不被打乱。
why.en: Working in parallel keeps the main thread focused and clean.

what.zh: 开一个继承当前对话内容的新助手。
what.en: Starts a helper that inherits everything discussed so far.

why.zh: 后续分析接着现有背景做，不用重复解释。
why.en: Continues analysis with existing context instead of re-explaining.

what.zh: 用脚本安排多个助手分批并行完成任务。
what.en: A script runs many helpers in parallel stages to finish a big job.

why.zh: 大范围重复工作交给机器统一调度，更快更全。
why.en: Fans out repetitive work at scale for speed and coverage.

what.zh: 创建一个可长期协作的队友助手并给它起名。
what.en: Creates a named teammate agent that can keep working with you.

why.zh: 让不同角色各管一摊，长期配合完成大项目。
why.en: Gives different roles their own lane for larger projects.

what.zh: 向另一个助手发送一条消息或补充要求。
what.en: Sends a message or extra instruction to another agent.

why.zh: 中途调整方向或补充信息，不必推翻重来。
why.en: Steers work mid-flight without starting over.

what.zh: 停下来等待某个助手完成当前工作。
what.en: Waits until a given agent finishes its current work.

why.zh: 只在确实需要结果时才等，避免空转和误判。
why.en: Waits only when the result is truly needed.

what.zh: 要求某个正在工作的助手立即停下。
what.en: Asks a working agent to stop what it is doing.

why.zh: 发现走错方向就马上止损，省下时间。
why.en: Cuts losses the moment a direction turns out wrong.

what.zh: 列出所有助手以及它们当前的状态。
what.en: Lists all helper agents and what each one is doing.

why.zh: 先看清谁在忙什么，再决定下一步找谁。
why.en: Sees who is doing what before deciding whom to involve.

what.zh: 列出可给助手选用的模型与思考强度。
what.en: Lists which models and reasoning levels helpers can use.

why.zh: 按任务难度挑合适的脑力，兼顾效果和成本。
why.en: Matches model power to task difficulty for better value.

what.zh: 在共享任务板上新建一条任务。
what.en: Adds a new task to the shared team task board.

why.zh: 把分工写下来，大家才不会重复或遗漏。
why.en: Writes down the split so nothing is duplicated or missed.

what.zh: 读取任务板上某条任务的详细内容。
what.en: Reads the full details of one task on the shared board.

why.zh: 动手前确认任务的范围和当前状态。
why.en: Confirms scope and status before starting the work.

what.zh: 列出任务板上的所有任务和进展。
what.en: Lists every task on the board along with its progress.

why.zh: 从全局看整体分工，决定先做哪一件。
why.en: Sees the whole board to decide what to do next.

what.zh: 修改任务的状态、负责人或说明。
what.en: Changes a task's status, owner, or description.

why.zh: 让队友随时看到最新进展，减少来回追问。
why.en: Keeps teammates current and avoids back-and-forth questions.

what.zh: 安排一条到点自动触发的提醒。
what.en: Schedules a reminder that fires at a chosen time.

why.zh: 把要等的事交给时间，不用一直守着。
why.en: Lets time handle waiting instead of watching the clock.

what.zh: 列出当前已经设置的所有提醒。
what.en: Lists all reminders currently set in the session.

why.zh: 确认哪些事已经安排好了、哪些还没做。
why.en: Checks what is already scheduled and still pending.

what.zh: 取消一条已经设置的提醒。
what.en: Removes a reminder that is no longer needed.

why.zh: 计划变了就清理掉，避免旧提醒造成干扰。
why.en: Cleans up when plans change so old reminders do not mislead.

what.zh: 调整已有提醒的时间或提醒内容。
what.en: Changes the time or content of an existing reminder.

why.zh: 小改动直接更新，比删掉重建更省事。
why.en: Adjusts in place instead of deleting and recreating.

what.zh: 在以前的对话记录里搜索相关内容。
what.en: Searches earlier session logs for matching content.

why.zh: 找回过去做过的事，避免重复劳动。
why.en: Recovers past work so it does not need redoing.

what.zh: 打开某段历史会话，读取其中的事件。
what.en: Opens a past session and reads its recorded events.

why.zh: 复盘当时发生了什么，弄清来龙去脉。
why.en: Reconstructs what happened and why it happened.

what.zh: 在历史事件里按关键词查找。
what.en: Finds recorded events by keyword across sessions.

why.zh: 从大量记录里快速定位关键那一刻。
why.en: Pinpoints the key moment inside a large history.

what.zh: 查看某次操作前后的关联事件链条。
what.en: Shows the chain of related events around one action.

why.zh: 顺藤摸瓜，看清一步动作的因果。
why.en: Follows the chain to see cause and effect.

what.zh: 按顺序回看一次会话的完整过程。
what.en: Replays a whole session step by step in order.

why.zh: 整体复盘解决思路，提炼可复用的方法。
why.en: Reviews the whole approach and extracts reusable steps.

what.zh: 登记一个会跨多轮持续推进的目标。
what.en: Registers an objective that persists across many rounds.

why.zh: 大任务需要连续性，不能做一半就断掉。
why.en: Big work needs continuity so it is not dropped halfway.

what.zh: 读取当前目标的内容和进度信息。
what.en: Reads the current goal and its progress details.

why.zh: 随时对表，确认没有跑偏或漏做。
why.en: Checks alignment so the work does not drift.

what.zh: 修改目标内容，或标记完成、暂停。
what.en: Edits a goal or marks it done, paused, or blocked.

why.zh: 让目标始终反映真实情况，方便下次继续。
why.en: Keeps the goal truthful so work can resume properly.

what.zh: 列出本机可查询的插件信息入口。
what.en: Lists the inspectors that can query plugins on this machine.

why.zh: 先看清有哪些接口，才知道能改什么。
why.en: Knows what is available before changing anything.

what.zh: 向某个入口查询插件的具体配置和数据。
what.en: Asks one inspector for a plugin's exact settings and data.

why.zh: 基于真实配置动手，而不是凭猜测改。
why.en: Acts on real settings instead of guessing.

what.zh: 查看当前插件自己的信息与结构。
what.en: Inspects the running plugin's own information and structure.

why.zh: 改自己之前先了解自己，避免改坏。
why.en: Understands itself before changing itself.

what.zh: 在运行环境中执行一段插件脚本。
what.en: Executes a short plugin script in the live runtime.

why.zh: 马上试一下想法，比空想更快得到反馈。
why.en: Tests an idea immediately rather than theorizing.

what.zh: 注册一个新的插件或其中一部分。
what.en: Registers a new plugin or one of its parts.

why.zh: 把想要的功能变成真正可用的东西。
why.en: Turns a desired feature into something that actually works.

what.zh: 让某个正在运行的插件停下来。
what.en: Stops a plugin that is currently running.

why.zh: 出问题先停住，避免影响继续扩大。
why.en: Halts first when something breaks to contain the damage.

what.zh: 从运行环境中彻底移除一个插件。
what.en: Removes a plugin entirely from the runtime.

why.zh: 不要的东西清理干净，减少隐患。
why.en: Cleans out what is not needed to reduce risk.

what.zh: 开一个可以持续交互的终端会话。
what.en: Opens a terminal session you can keep interacting with.

why.zh: 需要反复输入的场景，用交互终端更顺手。
why.en: Interactive terminals suit tasks that need repeated input.

what.zh: 查看终端里最新的输出内容。
what.en: Shows the latest output inside a terminal session.

why.zh: 看程序反馈，判断下一步该输入什么。
why.en: Reads feedback to decide the next input.

what.zh: 列出当前所有打开的终端会话。
what.en: Lists every terminal session currently open.

why.zh: 同时开多个终端时，先确认操作哪一个。
why.en: With several terminals open, confirms which one to use.

what.zh: 向终端进程发送中断等控制信号。
what.en: Sends a control signal such as an interrupt to a terminal.

why.zh: 程序卡住时能及时打断，不必干等。
why.en: Breaks out of a stuck program instead of waiting.

what.zh: 关闭一个已经开着的终端会话。
what.en: Closes an open terminal session.

why.zh: 用完就关，保持环境干净、不占资源。
why.en: Closes what is done to keep the environment clean.

what.zh: 查询代码里定义、引用和报错的位置。
what.en: Looks up where symbols are defined, used, or reported as errors.

why.zh: 用工具精确定位，比逐行翻文件更快更准。
why.en: Locates precisely instead of scrolling through files.

what.zh: 让助手反复执行直到任务完成。
what.en: Keeps the agent working in repeated rounds until done.

why.zh: 需要长时间打磨的任务，靠循环一步步逼近目标。
why.en: Long polishing work converges step by step through rounds.
